column5: ★★★ THE FRAME IS WRONG AND NEEDS A REDRAW - THE APP IS RIGHT. This is the inverted case: do NOT bring the build to the design. Report 055f32b9 ("Video Poker Multipliers Mismatching"): the Figma paytable prints 60x for Straight Flush and 22x for 4 of a Kind where the server pays 50x and 25x. Confirmed live in Figma 2026-08-26 at text nodes 9758:6724 / 9758:6729 (desktop paytable PANEL 9758-6712, 754x302 - the id report 0241f386 addresses it by; 055f32b9 linked its inner content frame 9758:6713 instead) and 9760:9622 / 9760:9627 (the scaled copy THIS catalog tracks, frame 9760-9610). Neither 9758-6712 nor 9758-6713 is in the registry; 9760-9610 is, which is why the vverify row hangs off it. The frame's other seven rows (800 / 9.00 / 6.00 / 4.00 / 3.00 / 2.00 / 1.00) are the server values exactly, so it reads as a two-cell transcription slip rather than a different schedule. THE AUTHORITY IS supabase/functions/_shared/videoPoker.ts VP_PAYTABLE (9/6 Jacks or Better) - that table is what settles. CASEY RULED 2026-08-26: the 9/6 server table is correct and stays, the display must match what actually pays, and the Figma frame is the thing that gets redrawn. REDRAW: 9758:6724 and 9760:9622 -> 50x; 9758:6729 and 9760:9627 -> 25x. Nothing else on the board changes. WHY: adopting the frame's numbers is a net RTP CUT of ~0.60 points (4 of a Kind 25->22 = -0.709 pt at a 0.236255% quad rate; Straight Flush 50->60 = only +0.109 pt at 0.010931%), taking 99.54% to ~98.94% and roughly doubling the house edge 0.46% -> ~1.06%, against Casey's 2026-08-19 per-game standard-rates ruling which names 9/6 JoB at about 0.5%. (The report filed the estimate as 98.85% / 1.15%; recomputed it is ~98.94% / ~1.06% - the report's straight-flush term was an order of magnitude light. Same sign, same order, ruling unchanged.) GUARDED: videoPokerPaytable.test.tsx is 12/12 green and asserts every rendered multiplier equals the server table (parsed off disk) AND that the literals 60 and 22 never reach the module; mutating PAYTABLE to 60/22 turns 3 named tests red - verified 2026-08-26 from --reporter=json, then restored byte-exact. MEASURED LIVE at 1440 on /play/video-poker: all nine rows render the server value and no 60x / 22x appears anywhere on the board. Routed 2026-08-25 at /play/video-poker; was a 1024x720 dialog at scale 0.348 (Deal 74.8x18.1, currency chips 15-22px). Measured at 375: scale 1, Deal 309x52, currency 63x44, bet input 309x44, all controls reachable. The bet panel and the felt stack below lg on the route; the 176px "Jacks or Better" reference column was REMOVED (frame 9738:13155 draws nothing right of the felt, report ba2d184f), so the widget is TWO columns now, not the three this row used to claim. Held partial rather than done because only the paytable surface has been verified against Figma and the server this pass - the remaining video-poker frames are still undiffed.
